name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 8 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 53 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
